summary: Completed regression testing of the GngWar frontend booking flow, pricing, responsive behavior, production build, and public backend smoke endpoints. All requested frontend checks passed.

success_rate.backend: 100% smoke checks (2/2; booking API not applicable by design)

seed_data_creation: No backend seed data created. One browser-local booking was created and verified, then confirmation was dismissed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blank and partial submissions now show booking-form-error and do not write gngwar_booking. Complete submission persists the full booking and shows confirmation. All 12 cards expose six exact prices, modal pricing updates, mobile menu and overflow checks pass, and yarn build passes.
rca of the issue: The prior blank-submit defect was resolved by explicit submitBooking validation: it checks all five required values before calling onConfirm. Live retest confirmed invalid submissions return early, while complete submissions persist and confirm correctly. No APIs were mocked; booking persistence is intentionally browser localStorage and backend booking integration is not implemented by the requested scope.
